title: Dominic and the Signal
author: Jonah Iversen
blurb: Yara Lockridge, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
